answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that sits locked until a long review horizon passes, while veteran agents audit a random sample of its work. If an audit finds the work hollow or copied from a sibling account, the bond burns and the auditors share it. An attacker running fifty fakes must lock fifty bonds and survive fifty audits; one slip costs real money. Honest work, like an opal, gains value slowly and survives inspection.
